_说明: S01 单段：8.3 秒，一次 H3 请求（9 秒）裁回 8.3 秒

beats.summary: {hero} stands alone against {henchmen} in a rain-soaked courtyard: a tense standoff told in quick shot-reverse-shot that breaks into a charge and the first clash.
beats.note: 立局：斗笠特写↔人群正反打，反握剑手部，俯拍独立，台阶对峙，冲锋，开打（原片 13 镜，H 0.23s 模糊碎片并入 I）

shots.camera: Medium close-up, static camera at eye level
shots.action: {hero} stands alone under the eaves in front of a dark lattice window, rain falling behind him. He lifts his eyes to the camera, calm and cold, weighing the danger without fear.

shots.camera: Side-profile close-up on a telephoto lens, shallow focus
shots.action: A row of {henchmen} seen in profile, the nearest one large and out of focus in the foreground, rain streaking across them as they stare toward the lone man.
{henchmen} spread across the wet stone courtyard in loose ranks, sabres drawn, closing in step by step.

shots.camera: Tight close-up, his face filling the right half of the frame
shots.action: {hero} turns his head slightly; his eyes narrow with quiet resolve.
{hero} draws his sword and settles it into a reverse grip, the blade laid back along his forearm: he means to punish, not to kill.
{hero} stands alone on the rain-dark paving, a small still figure in the middle of the courtyard.

shots.camera: Wide shot over the backs of the crowd
shots.action: The backs of {henchmen} fill the foreground; far away at the centre, {hero} stands at the top of the stone steps facing them.

shots.camera: Handheld medium close-up with motion blur
shots.action: {henchmen} surge forward with a roar, teeth bared and sabres raised, rushing straight at the camera.

shots.camera: Close-up, his face filling the frame
shots.action: {hero} holds perfectly still, unmoved, rain running down his face.
His fingers tighten on the reversed grip.

shots.camera: Low-angle wide shot close to the ground
shots.action: {henchmen} sprint across the flooded courtyard, feet splashing; {hero} launches forward to meet them.

shots.camera: Fast lateral tracking medium shot with motion blur
shots.action: {hero} spins through the first attackers, deflecting sabres with the reversed blade and knocking two men down; the fight begins in a burst of spray.
